_comment: KagamiQA P2 — Known-failure baseline for blargg test ROM suite.
_policy: This file is version-controlled. Each entry documents a ROM known to FAIL. Entries with expected_to_eventually_pass=true are accuracy bugs to fix in P4. Entries with expected_to_eventually_pass=false are permanent skips (e.g. unsupported features or ROM format issues).
_governance: AI shall not modify this file. Baseline updates require the same review as code changes (per Plan §1.2 constraints 6-7).

failures.notes: CPU instruction test (all opcodes including unofficial). 0x80 indicates at least one failed instruction. Upstream FCEUX also fails some blargg instr_test ROMs.
CPU instruction test (official opcodes only). Same failure pattern as all_instrs — official opcode subset also triggers failures.
ROM load failure — 5x16k PRG NROM format is rejected by FCEUX11's ROM loader. Not an accuracy issue; ROM format compatibility issue.
PPU VBL NMI timing test. 0x01 indicates VBL/NMI timing does not match real hardware at 1-PPU-clock accuracy.
APU test (length counters, envelope, sweep, DMC). 0x01 indicates at least one APU behavior diverges from real hardware.
